subject: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com>, Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs

Hi Oliver & Amira,

Great to meet you both on the kickoff call earlier. Per our discussion, attached is a concise landing plan that covers SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists, and initial service-account patterns for Zephyr's staging and prod orgs. High-level asks for next week: 

- Confirm SAML IdP metadata (entityID & ACS URL) or let us know if you want Redwood to host metadata.
- Share the SCIM admin user (name/email) we should use for provisioning test accounts.
- Provide a short list of CIDR ranges for the initial IP allowlist for staging.

I've looped in Marissa from CS for rollout sequencing and Ben for the integration runbook and service-account naming questions. We'll aim for an internal handoff to support by Friday (5/16) if dependencies are green.

Attachments: SAML-config-template.yaml (fill in IdP values), zephyr-ip-allowlist-20250514.csv, redwood-onboard-checklist-v1.pdf

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs

Thanks Ava — attaching our IdP metadata and a preliminary CIDR list. Couple notes from our side: 

- We're on Okta; I'll attach the XML metadata as "okta-zephyr-metadata.xml" in a follow-up. ACS URL we expect is https://auth.redwood.ai/saml/consume (confirm this is your expected ACS).
- For SCIM, Amira will be the admin. Amira: can you confirm which email we should use for the SCIM admin account?
- Regarding service accounts: our security team prefers short-lived keys and an org-level naming scheme (zephyr-redwood-<env>-svc). We may have extra policy checks before prod.

Oliver
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Zephyr Labs
oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com

From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs

Ava — Amira here. Use amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com for the SCIM admin. A couple of clarifying Qs before we fill templates: 

1) SCIM scope: do you recommend full provisioning (users + groups) or start with users-only and add groups after initial cutover?
2) For SAML, can Redwood issue SP-initiated login links for our support users, or must we route everything through our IdP?

We'll populate the SAML template once we confirm the ACS and your SP entityID.

Thanks,
Amira Hassan
Identity & Access Lead, Zephyr Labs
amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs

Hi team — quick internal note and proposed sequencing (copying Zephyr for visibility):

- Day 0: Exchange SAML metadata + confirm ACS/entityID (Oliver to provide).
- Day 1: Staging SAML test (IdP metadata loaded in staging SP). Verify login and attributes (email, name, groups).
- Day 2: SCIM enable in staging (users-only) — run provisioning for a pilot group (10 users).
- Day 3: IP allowlist validation for staging (Redwood ops will whitelist provided CIDRs).
- Day 4: Service-account pattern and key rotation policy review with Zephyr security.
- Day 5: Prod cutover prep and rollback plan.

Ben — can you prepare the minimal runbook sections for Steps 1–3 (SAML test checklist, SCIM test checklist, IP whitelist verification) and drop them into the Drive link? I'll take the rollout ownership and coordinate approvals.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@zephyrlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls landing plan & handoff — Zephyr Labs

All — I've added the initial runbook snippets to the shared Drive (link above) and attached a short troubleshooting checklist for common SAML attribute mismatches. Key callouts: 

- Attribute mapping: ensure "email" comes through as the NameID or as an attribute named "emailAddress"; our staging SP will accept either but prod will be stricter.
- SCIM: we'll start users-only for the pilot; groups can be added in Phase 2 after we confirm membership sync reliability.
- IP allowlist: Redwood supports CIDR ranges and single IP entries; please mark any VPN egress ranges so we can include them in staging.

Next steps for Zephyr: send IdP XML and confirm amira.hassan@zephyrlabs.com as SCIM admin (Amira confirmed), and we'll schedule the staging SAML test for Mon 5/19 if that works for your team.

Attachments referenced: saml-attribute-troubleshooting.txt

Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
